frictions.description: After password login the app redirected to /dashboard instead of /email-delivery, so manual navigation back to the assigned route was required.
The delivery log page consistently rendered only the shared shell/filter bar while the results region failed to render any table rows or empty-state guidance.

blockers.description: Missing rendered delivery log content prevented validation of row-level behaviors, sorting, and search-result filtering through the real UI.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Reloaded the page, navigated with different filter/query combinations, and inspected DOM/network state; the results region still failed to render.

blockers.description: Error-state validation could not be performed without forcing an API failure, which would exceed the assigned browser-only observation boundary.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Confirmed normal API requests succeeded, then stopped short of disruptive fault injection.

summary: Tested 19 assigned assertions on the authenticated real page. 8 passed, 2 failed (VAL-DL-014 empty state, VAL-CROSS-005 header badge), and 9 were blocked because the delivery log results region did not render on the browser surface.
